Players Committee card image of [[Slip Sliding Away (V)]] (Virtual Set 12), as first published (no errata mark), printing: “If you have deployed a site with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a battleground site. Then, unless you have deployed a site with "Palace" in title, may deploy up to three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” Uploaded unchanged.
